response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(archstat, 'Missing') as archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) as tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY COALESCE(archstat, 'Missing')), with_share AS (SELECT archstat, tally, CAST(tally AS REAL) / SUM(tally) OVER () as share FROM status_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_val FROM with_share) SELECT w.archstat, w.tally, w.share, w.share - a.avg_val as above_average FROM with_share w CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE w.share > a.avg_val
